meta.items_per_mastered_concept: sum over seeds of executed planned activities (lessons + exercises, diagnostic items excluded) / sum over seeds of required concepts (goal + ancestors) with true theta >= 0.70 at episode end; concepts already mastered at day 0 count in the denominator
meta.km_censoring: episodes without goal mastery are censored at minutes used (informative censoring, FINAL_A5 convention); RMST tau = max minutes available
meta.calibration_method: Brier exact (SSE/n over in-loop attempts); AUC Mann-Whitney on per-seed 100-bin histograms, bin-mean predictions (approximate)
